; ============================================================
; Round 4 — identifier type-suffix in value position, Set with
; an indexed target, and VB6 graphics methods (Line/Circle/PSet)
; ============================================================

; ------------------------------------------------------------
; B — identifier with a type-declaration suffix used as a value
;     or index. "&" must bind as the type suffix, not as the
;     concatenation operator with a missing operand.
; ------------------------------------------------------------

==================
Round4-B1 suffixed identifier as a value
==================

Sub T()
x = STATE_MIXED&
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (assignment_statement
        target: (identifier)
        value: (typed_identifier (identifier) (type_hint))))))

==================
Round4-B2 suffixed identifier as an array index
==================

Sub T()
v = a(I&)
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (assignment_statement
        target: (identifier)
        value: (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (argument_list_inner
              (typed_identifier (identifier) (type_hint)))))))))

; ------------------------------------------------------------
; C — Set with an indexed (array-element) target.
; ------------------------------------------------------------

==================
Round4-C1 Set an array element to Nothing
==================

Sub T()
Set a(0) = Nothing
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (set_statement
        target: (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          (argument_list (argument_list_inner (literal (integer_literal)))))
        value: (literal (nothing_literal))))))

==================
Round4-C2 Set an array element to a new object
==================

Sub T()
Set m(1) = New Collection
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (set_statement
        target: (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          (argument_list (argument_list_inner (literal (integer_literal)))))
        value: (new_expression (builtin_type))))))

; ------------------------------------------------------------
; D — VB6 graphics methods. Coordinate pairs "(x, y)" and the
;     "Line (..)-(..)" form, optionally qualified by a surface.
; ------------------------------------------------------------

==================
Round4-D1 Line with coordinate-pair syntax on a surface
==================

Sub T()
UserControl.Line (0, 0)-(100, 100)
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (graphics_method_statement
        object: (graphics_object (identifier))
        from: (graphics_coord
          x: (literal (integer_literal))
          y: (literal (integer_literal)))
        to: (graphics_coord
          x: (literal (integer_literal))
          y: (literal (integer_literal)))))))

==================
Round4-D2 Line with color and box-fill flag
==================

Sub T()
Line (0, 0)-(50, 50), vbRed, BF
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (graphics_method_statement
        from: (graphics_coord
          x: (literal (integer_literal))
          y: (literal (integer_literal)))
        to: (graphics_coord
          x: (literal (integer_literal))
          y: (literal (integer_literal)))
        color: (identifier)))))

==================
Round4-D3 Circle with radius and color
==================

Sub T()
Circle (100, 100), 50, vbRed
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (graphics_method_statement
        center: (graphics_coord
          x: (literal (integer_literal))
          y: (literal (integer_literal)))
        radius: (literal (integer_literal))
        (identifier)))))

==================
Round4-D4 PSet with a color
==================

Sub T()
PSet (10, 10), vbBlack
End Sub

---

(source_file
  (sub_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    (parameter_list)
    (block
      (graphics_method_statement
        point: (graphics_coord
          x: (literal (integer_literal))
          y: (literal (integer_literal)))
        color: (identifier)))))
